# Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust 26.7.0

Initial public release of `aspose-cells-foss-rust`, a pure-Rust, MIT-licensed library for reading and writing Excel `.xlsx` workbooks with an Aspose.Cells-style API.

## Highlights

- Pure-Rust `.xlsx` read/write support
- Familiar `Workbook` / `Worksheet` / `Cells` object model
- No proprietary runtime or external Aspose dependency
- OOXML packaging and SpreadsheetML handling implemented from scratch

## Included

- Workbook and worksheet create/load/save workflows
- Cell values, formulas, and cached formula results
- Styles, number formats, borders, fills, and alignment
- Rows, columns, merged cells, and worksheet settings
- Data validation and conditional formatting
- Hyperlinks and defined names
- Comments, charts, tables, pictures, and shapes
- Auto-filters, sparklines, document properties, and page setup

## Samples and docs

- Runnable samples for the main feature areas are included under `samples/`
- CI workflows cover formatting, checks, linting, sample smoke runs, and docs publishing
- Rustdoc can be generated locally with `cargo doc --no-deps`

## Package info

- Package: `aspose-cells-foss-rust`
- Library import: `aspose_cells_foss_rust`
- Rust edition: `2021`
- License: `MIT`

## Status

This project is early-stage and evolving. The public API surface is already broad, but some Aspose.Cells features are not implemented yet or are only partially implemented.
